messages:
Evan Rivera: Hi folks — Evan here, first day on Systems! East coast timezone. Quick intro: previously on infra at a fintech startup. Excited to join. Two quick setup asks below.
Alex Kim: Welcome Evan :tada: Im Alex, your manager. We'll do a 1:1 at 3pm today. For setup, ping Gina for access and IT for badge.
Gina (DevEx): Hey Evan :wave: welcome! I just sent the org invite and added you to #systems and #oncall-ops. Please confirm the email you used to sign up so I can sync SSO groups.
Evan Rivera: Thanks Gina — evan.rivera@personalmail.com. Also I tried to ssh into the jumpbox but got permission denied. Any temp command I should run?
IT Support: Hi Evan — badge pickup is at HQ reception between 10-4, bring ID. For SSH, make sure you joined the "redwood-ssg" LDAP group. If not, run: ```ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "evan.rivera@personalmail.com"; ssh-copy-id -i ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub jumpbox@jump.redwood.internal``` Reply here when done and we'll authorize.
DevEx Bot: New-hire onboarding checklist created for Evan Rivera  tasks: SSO enroll, MDM, security training, payroll.
Evan Rivera: Generated keys and did ssh-copy-id, still seeing "Permission denied (publickey)". Should I open a ticket?
Gina (DevEx): Hmm. I sent a request to IT to add you to the LDAP group; if they haven't finished, open a quick ticket with subject "LDAP add - Evan Rivera". I'll share the ticket link in a sec.
IT Support: Ticket created: TKT-4821. I'll take it. In the meantime, I can create a temp bastion account for you: username evan_temp. Password will be DM'd.
Alex Kim: We'll also set up a buddy rotation — @Marta typically pairs new engineers for the first week. Marta, can you help Evan get initial runbook walkthroughs tomorrow?
Gina (DevEx): @Evan FYI I invited you to the onboarding calendar and dropped links to the runbooks: https://redwood.example/runbooks/systems -> check "first-week checklist".
Evan Rivera: Got the runbook link and ticket number, thanks everyone. Fun fact: I make terrible sourdough but have a pretty great tea collection :tea:
Alex Kim: Love it. Welcome to the team, Evan — excited to have you. We'll get the access sorted today. :rocket:
Evan Rivera: Appreciate it — see you all on the 1:1 later.
